title: Goose Fra Ba
style: slow chill folk, 72 BPM, warm acoustic guitar, soft brushed drum, gentle bass, calm low male vocal in english, friendly storyteller tone, breathy hook, small smile in the voice, no auto-tune, no edm, no aggressive production, intimate kitchen scale, room ambience
lyrics:
[Intro — almost spoken]
Goose fra ba
Goose fra ba
Slow it down now
Goose fra ba

[Verse 1]
When the day gets loud and your shoulder starts to lift
When the jaw starts clicking and the eye starts to drift
You don't have to fix it, you don't have to fight
Just say the silly words and let them land light
Goose fra ba
Easy on the inhale
Goose fra ba
Easy on the way out

[Chorus]
Goose fra ba, goose fra ba
That's the corey ai way
Goose fra ba, goose fra ba
Soft hands, soft day
The tic don't run the room
The breath does
Goose fra ba

[Verse 2]
Three syllables, three little doors
Open the first one, close the next one, soft on the floors
You can say it in the car, you can say it in the line
You can say it in your head when the world is unkind
Goose fra ba
Loosen up the jawline
Goose fra ba
Loosen up the spine

[Bridge — half-spoken, like a friend]
Look, it's not magic, it's not a cure
It's a silly little phrase that makes you sure
Of one small thing, that you can choose
The next three syllables you use
Three three six
Goose fra ba
That's the corey ai way

[Chorus 2 — slightly fuller]
Goose fra ba, goose fra ba
That's the corey ai way
Goose fra ba, goose fra ba
Soft hands, soft day
The tic don't run the room
The breath does
Goose fra ba

[Outro — fades, quiet]
Goose fra ba
Goose fra ba
You good
You good
Goose fra ba
